episodes.title: MSP: Myths and Facts
sources: PIB, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, "Increasing Coverage of Crops under Minimum Support Price", 12 Dec 2025, https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2203209 (read 2026-11-19)
Indian Economic Service, Arthapedia, "Minimum Support Prices", https://ies.gov.in/arthapedia/concept/minimum-support-prices (read 2026-11-19)
Lok Sabha Unstarred Question No. 319, 22 July 2025, https://eparlib.sansad.in/bitstream/123456789/2996894/1/AU319_snVEpk.pdf (read 2026-11-19)

All India Radio News, "Union Cabinet hikes Minimum Support Prices for Rabi crops for 2027-28 marketing season", 1 Oct 2026, https://newsonair.gov.in/union-cabinet-hikes-minimum-support-prices-for-rabi-crops-for-2027-28-marketing-season/ (read 2026-11-19)

DeshGujarat, 30 Sep 2026, reproducing the CCEA decision and MSP table, https://deshgujarat.com/2026/09/30/union-cabinet-approves-hike-in-msp-for-all-rabi-crops-for-2027-28-marketing-season/ (read 2026-11-19; secondary)

quiz.q: Who decides the MSPs after the commission recommends them?
options: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs
quiz.why: CACP recommends; the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approves.

quiz.q: Since Union Budget 2018-19, MSP is meant to be at least how much over the average cost of production?
options: One and a half times the cost
Ten per cent above the cost
quiz.why: The 2018-19 Budget announced MSP at a level of at least 1.5 times the all-India weighted average cost of production.

quiz.q: For how many mandated crops does the Government fix MSPs?
quiz.why: MSPs are fixed for 22 mandated crops: 14 kharif, 6 rabi and 2 commercial.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. Retold lines: none. Moving facts: rabi 2027-28 wheat MSP Rs 2,610 (as of 30 Sep 2026); count of 22 crops (as of Dec 2025). The line that MSP is a government price backed by agency buying, not a law binding every buyer, is the producer's reading of the sources, not a quoted sentence. The myth claims are invented sayings, not quotes.

episodes.title: Aryabhata Goes to Space
sources: ISRO, "Aryabhata", https://www.isro.gov.in/aryabhata_1.html (read 2026-11-19)
U R Rao Satellite Centre (ISRO), "Aryabhata" (last updated 30 Jun 2015), https://www.ursc.gov.in/experimental-satellites/html/aryabhata.jsp (read 2026-11-19)

quiz.q: Which rocket carried Aryabhata into orbit in 1975?
options: A Soviet Kosmos-3M from Kapustin Yar
An American Delta from Cape Canaveral
quiz.why: A Soviet Kosmos-3M rocket launched it from Kapustin Yar on 19 April 1975.

quiz.q: What is Aryabhata's place in India's space story?
options: India's first satellite, designed and built in India
India's first communication satellite in geostationary orbit
quiz.why: ISRO calls it India's first satellite, completely designed and fabricated in India.

quiz.q: When did Aryabhata re-enter Earth's atmosphere?
quiz.why: It re-entered on 10 February 1992, after nearly seventeen years; its mainframe worked until March 1981.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. The diary is imagined: the satellite 'writes' in the first person, but every fact comes from ISRO and URSC pages. Retold lines: all first-person phrasing. Moving facts: none. The engineers in the pictures are made up.

episodes.title: To the Moon's South Pole
sources: ISRO, "Chandrayaan-1", https://www.isro.gov.in/Chandrayaan_1.html (read 2026-11-19)
ISRO, "Chandrayaan-3" and "Chandrayaan-3 Details", https://www.isro.gov.in/Chandrayaan3.html (read 2026-11-19)
Wikipedia, "Chandrayaan-1", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandrayaan-1 (read 2026-11-19; secondary)
Wikipedia, "Chandrayaan-2", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandrayaan-2 (read 2026-11-19; secondary, ISRO's Chandrayaan-2 pages not reachable)
Wikipedia, "Chandrayaan-3", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chandrayaan-3 (read 2026-11-19; secondary, for the south-pole landing and 'fourth country')

quiz.q: Which mission did India launch first?
quiz.why: Chandrayaan-1 launched on 22 October 2008, India's first Moon mission.

quiz.q: What did Chandrayaan-3 achieve in August 2023?
options: A soft landing near the Moon's south pole
quiz.why: Vikram soft-landed on 23 August 2023, making India the fourth country to land on the Moon.

quiz.q: What did Chandrayaan-1 help find in the lunar soil?
quiz.why: Chandrayaan-1 helped find widespread water molecules in lunar soil. Sulphur was confirmed later by Chandrayaan-3's rover.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. Retold lines: none. Moving facts: the Chandrayaan-2 orbiter still working (as of 2026-11-19). The Chandrayaan-2, water and south-pole items rest on Wikipedia summaries because ISRO's own pages could not be reached.

episodes.title: Two Sides: GM Mustard
sources: Gene Campaign v. Union of India, Supreme Court of India, split verdict of 23 July 2024, as reported by SCC Online (27 Jul 2024) and SpicyIP (Aug 2024), read 2026-11-19
ThePrint, 'More than 50% edible oil imported, ban on GM mustard against national interest, Centre tells SC' (19 Jan 2024), reporting the Union's written note, read 2026-11-19
ClearIAS explainer 'GM mustard' (DMH-11: developer, reported yield advantage, concerns), read 2026-11-19
Business Standard, 'SC to take up GM mustard case challenging Centre's nod from April 15' (6 Mar 2025), read 2026-11-19

quiz.q: What did both Supreme Court judges agree the Centre should do in July 2024?
options: Frame a national policy on GM crops, consulting states and farmers
Approve GM mustard for sale at once
Hand GM approvals to the states
quiz.why: Though they split on the approval itself, both asked for a national policy on GM crops, made in consultation with stakeholders.

quiz.q: In a Mains answer on a contested topic like this, what is the sound approach?
options: Argue only the side you prefer
Both sides fairly, then a balanced way forward
Skip the arguments and list dates
quiz.why: The video's takeaway: set out both sides fairly, then suggest a balanced way forward.

quiz.q: Which body gave the conditional approval for GM mustard's environmental release in October 2022?
quiz.why: The Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC), under the environment ministry, gave a conditional approval in October 2022.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. Speakers are made up. Balance check: three arguments each side, words within 10% in both languages; no verdict. Moving fact: court status as of 19 Nov 2026 (no final ruling found). Secondary sources: court details via SCC Online/SpicyIP; yield claim via ClearIAS.

episodes.title: Mangroves: Myth or Fact?
sources: NCERT, Contemporary India (Class IX Geography), ch. 5 'Natural Vegetation and Wildlife', section on mangrove forests (archive.org item ncert-iess1, file iess105), read 2026-11-16
NCERT, Biology (Class XI), ch. 5 'Morphology of Flowering Plants', 5.1 root modifications (archive.org item ncert-kebo1), read 2026-11-16

Forest Survey of India, India State of Forest Report 2023: mangrove cover 4,991.68 sq km (0.15% of area; West Bengal 42.45%), as stated in Rajya Sabha on 6 Feb 2025 and reported by Down To Earth; PIB backgrounder, 24 Oct 2025 (about 4,992 sq km), read 2026-11-16
Government of India, India Science & Technology portal, 'Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes (MISHTI)', read 2026-11-16
ICFRE-Coastal Ecosystem Centre (MoEFCC), report on the International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem, 26 July 2025, read 2026-11-16

quiz.q: What do mangroves help to hold back along the coast?
quiz.why: They help prevent coastal erosion, and also store carbon and support fisheries.

quiz.q: Which statement about India's mangroves is correct?
options: They are found only in the Sundarbans
They cover about a quarter of India
They also line the Mahanadi, Krishna, Godavari and Kaveri deltas
They grow only on dry hills
quiz.why: Mangroves cover several east-coast deltas; the Sundarbans are the best known, and West Bengal has the largest share.

quiz.q: About what share of India's area do mangroves cover (ISFR 2023)?
quiz.why: About 4,992 sq km, roughly 0.15% of the country's area.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. The four myths are claims made up for the format. Moving fact: mangrove area (ISFR 2023, latest edition found as of 19 Nov 2026). Secondary: the ISFR figure via Down To Earth and PIB.

episodes.title: Case File: The Flood Warning at Two a.m.
sources: The Disaster Management Act, 2005, sections 25(2)(a) and 34 (text via PRS India), read 2026-11-19

National Disaster Management Authority, National Disaster Management Guidelines: Management of Floods (2008), paras 8.1.3 (Evacuation Plan) and 5.4 (Regulation of Reservoirs), copy via indiawaterportal.org, read 2026-11-19

quiz.q: In the case, what did the officer's sound answer do first with the dam warning?
options: Confirmed it and woke the right team
Left it to the dam engineer
quiz.why: A sound answer confirms the warning, wakes the right people, moves the low villages first and keeps everyone informed.

quiz.q: According to the NDMA flood guidelines, evacuation should be carried out:
options: Only after the flood has peaked
quiz.why: Para 8.1.3 says evacuation should be a precautionary measure based on warning indicators, prior to impact.

quiz.q: Who chairs the District Disaster Management Authority under the DM Act, 2005?
quiz.why: Section 25(2)(a): the Collector, District Magistrate or Deputy Commissioner is the ex officio Chairperson.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. A made-up case: the officer, dam and villages are invented. Retold: shots 06-08 paraphrase the guidelines and the Act. Moving facts: none.

episodes.title: Cyclone Phailin: Emptying a Coast
sources: India Meteorological Department, Very Severe Cyclonic Storm PHAILIN over the Bay of Bengal (08-14 October 2013): A Report (Cyclone Warning Division, October 2013), read 2026-11-19
Government of Odisha and World Bank, India: Cyclone Phailin in Odisha, October 2013: Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment (2013), read 2026-11-19

quiz.q: Roughly how many people were moved to safety in the 36 hours before Phailin made landfall?
quiz.why: Odisha's assessment says over a million people were evacuated within 36 hours before landfall.

quiz.q: Which set of measures best explains the far lower toll than in 1999?
options: Early warning, shelters, drills and timely evacuation
Sea walls along the whole coast
quiz.why: The Odisha assessment credits preparedness: forecasts, shelters, mock drills, satellite phones and evacuation before landfall.

quiz.q: Near which place did Cyclone Phailin cross the coast on 12 October 2013?
quiz.why: IMD's report places landfall near Gopalpur, in Ganjam district of Odisha.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. SERIOUS tone: no music, no effects. Sources differ on deaths (44 in the Odisha/World Bank assessment; 21 plus 17 flood deaths in IMD's table) and on evacuees (about 984,000 in IMD's table; over a million in the assessment); the script uses the World Bank figure and says 'about a million'. Moving facts: none.

episodes.title: The Budget's Year
sources: Constitution of India, Articles 112-117 (text as reproduced at constitutionofindia.net: /articles/article-112-annual-financial-statement/, article-113-procedure-in-parliament-with-respect-to-estimates/, article-114-appropriation-bills/, article-115-supplementary-additional-or-excess-grants/, article-117-special-provisions-as-to-financial-bills/); read 2026-11-19. Article 116 summarised from https://www.gktoday.in/article-116 (secondary)

PRS Legislative Research, Union Budget Primer, https://prsindia.org/files/budget/Union_Budget_Primer.pdf (read 2026-11-19): budget circular timing, general discussion, Standing Committees, voting on demands, Appropriation Bill, Finance Bill, supplementary demands
General Clauses Act, 1897, section 3(21) (financial year begins on 1 April), https://www.advocatekhoj.com/library/bareacts/generalclauses/3.php (read 2026-11-19)

GKToday, Union Budget: Process, Components and Constitutional Provisions (Budget on 1 February since 2017; secondary), https://www.gktoday.in/union-budget-process-components-and-constitutional-provisions/; All India Radio News, 1 Feb 2026, Union Budget 2026-27 in the Lok Sabha, https://newsonair.gov.in/fm-nirmala-sitharaman-presents-union-budget-2026-27-in-lok-sabha-today/ (both read 2026-11-19)

quiz.q: Which Article requires the annual financial statement, the Budget, to be laid before Parliament?
quiz.why: Article 112 requires a statement of estimated receipts and expenditure for every financial year to be laid before both Houses.

quiz.q: Demands for grants are submitted to which House?
quiz.why: Article 113(2): estimates other than charged expenditure go to the House of the People as demands for grants, which it may assent to, refuse or reduce.

quiz.q: What does Article 114 say about money leaving the Consolidated Fund of India?
options: It needs only the Finance Minister's order
It can leave only under an appropriation made by law
It needs the Rajya Sabha's vote alone
It needs no approval within the year
quiz.why: No money may be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund except under appropriation made by law (Article 114(3)).

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. Retold lines: none. Secondary: the Articles were read from a reproduction of the Constitution, Article 116 and the 1 February since 2017 line from GKToday. The month stamps (Aug-Sep, Mar) are the producer's placing of the steps, not quoted dates. Moving facts: Budget date as of Feb 2026.

episodes.title: Phishing: Myths and Facts
sources: CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team, MeitY), Cyber Security Best Practices for Senior Citizens, National Cyber Security Awareness Month, October 2025, pp. 3-9; PDF read in full 2026-11-19 at https://www.csk.gov.in/documents/CERT-In-NCSAM-Book_2025-10-01.pdf

quiz.q: Which of these is a phishing route named in the CERT-In booklet?
quiz.why: The booklet lists quishing: fake payment QR codes and phishing via QR codes, alongside smishing and vishing.

quiz.q: What should you do if a caller creates panic and asks for bank details?
options: Hang up and use the bank's official number
Ask them to call back on a friend's phone
quiz.why: CERT-In advises hanging up if the caller pressures you, and using customer-care numbers from official websites.

quiz.q: If you become a victim of cyber fraud, what does the booklet advise?
options: Post about it and wait for replies
quiz.why: The booklet says: if you become a victim, immediately call 1930 and report cyber frauds at the national cybercrime portal.

review.note: Facts were read against the CERT-In booklet listed. Retold lines: none. The myths are invented sayings, not quotes. 'Urgency is the bait' is the producer's wording of the booklet's advice on urgent messages and panic. The helpline 1930 and the cybercrime portal rest on that booklet alone (the portal itself could not be read automatically). Moving facts: none (as of the booklet, October 2025).

episodes.title: Case File: The Relief List
sources: The Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1964, Rule 3(1), clauses (xv), (xvi), (xvii), as inserted by the CCS (Conduct) (Third Amendment) Rules, 2014 (DoPT notification, 27 November 2014); text read 2026-11-19 from a reproduction at https://aaptaxlaw.com/ccsc-rules/rule-3-ccsc-rules-general-3-central-civil-services-conduct-rules-1964.html

Second Administrative Reforms Commission, Fourth Report, Ethics in Governance (2007), para 2.2.5 (principles of public life: merit, accountability, openness); read 2026-11-19 at https://darpg.gov.in/sites/default/files/ethics4.pdf

quiz.q: What did Tara notice about one name on the relief list?
options: It was missing from the damage survey
quiz.why: The family had no recorded damage, yet the name was on a list meant for people who lost homes.

quiz.q: Under CCS (Conduct) Rules, Rule 3(1)(xvi), a civil servant should take decisions on what basis?
quiz.why: Rule 3(1)(xvi) asks officers to make choices, take decisions and make recommendations on merit alone.

quiz.q: Why is Option B, striking the name quietly, still weak?
options: It leaves no record and is not open
quiz.why: The 2nd ARC lists accountability and openness: officers should be answerable and as open as possible about their decisions.

review.note: Facts were read against the sources listed. A made-up case: the Collector, the flood, the list and the man named Dhanraj are invented. Retold lines: none. Secondary: Rule 3 text read from a reproduction, not the Gazette. The sound-answer steps are the producer's reading of the rules and the 2nd ARC principles, not a quoted list. Moving facts: none.
